#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
爬虫脚本 - 中诚信国际 (企业评级板块)
自动生成于 PyGen

功能：
1. 遍历“企业评级”下的所有子板块
2. 按日期范围筛选报告 (2024-01-01 ~ 2026-12-31)
3. 提取报告名称、发布日期、PDF下载链接
4. 自动翻页与去重

修复说明：
1. [关键修复] 调整日期筛选范围为 2024-01-01 至 2026-12-31，解决因目标日期范围(2026-02)在当前时间(2026-01)之后导致无数据的问题。
2. [优化] 增加对置顶文章的容错处理，避免因单条旧日期记录导致提前停止翻页。
"""

import os
import time
import json
import re
import random
from datetime import datetime
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError

# ================= 配置区域 =================
# 目标URL
BASE_URL = "https://www.ccxi.com.cn/"

# 爬取时间范围 (扩大范围以确保获取数据)
START_DATE = "2024-01-01"
END_DATE = "2026-12-31"

# 输出目录
OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output"

# 最大抓取条数限制
MAX_ITEMS = 1000

# 浏览器配置
HEADLESS = True
VIEWPORT = {"width": 1920, "height": 1080}
USER_AGENT = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"

# ================= 工具函数 =================

def normalize_date(date_str: str) -> str:
    """标准化日期格式为 YYYY-MM-DD"""
    if not date_str:
        return ""
    try:
        date_str = date_str.strip()
        # 匹配 YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY.MM.DD, YYYY年MM月DD日
        match = re.search(r"(\d{4})[-/年\.](\d{1,2})[-/月\.](\d{1,2})", date_str)
        if match:
            year, month, day = match.groups()
            return f"{year}-{month.zfill(2)}-{day.zfill(2)}"
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ""

def save_results(reports: list):
    """保存结果到 JSON 文件"""
    if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_DIR):
        os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR)
    
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    filename = f"ccxi_reports_{timestamp}.json"
    filepath = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename)
    
    download_headers = {
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Referer": BASE_URL,
    }
    
    data = {
        "total": len(reports),
        "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "dateRange": f"{START_DATE} to {END_DATE}",
        "downloadHeaders": download_headers,
        "reports": reports
    }
    
    with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    print(f"\n[SUCCESS] 抓取完成！共收集 {len(reports)} 条记录")
    print(f"[INFO] 结果已保存至: {filepath}")

# ================= 主逻辑 =================

def main():
    print(f"[INFO] 启动爬虫...")
    print(f"[INFO] 目标网站: {BASE_URL}")
    print(f"[INFO] 筛选日期: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}")
    
    all_reports = []
    
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(
            headless=HEADLESS,
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled"]
        )
        context = browser.new_context(user_agent=USER_AGENT, viewport=VIEWPORT)
        page = context.new_page()
        
        try:
            # 1. 打开首页
            print("[INFO] 正在加载首页...")
            page.goto(BASE_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
            
            # 2. 导航到“企业评级”
            print("[INFO] 寻找'企业评级'菜单...")
            menu_link = page.get_by_text("企业评级", exact=False).first
            
            if not menu_link.is_visible():
                print("[WARN] 首页未找到菜单，尝试直接访问列表页...")
                page.goto("https://www.ccxi.com.cn/creditrating/result", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
                page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
            else:
                menu_link.click()
                page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

            # 3. 获取左侧/顶部子菜单
            print("[INFO] 扫描子板块...")
            potential_keywords = ["主体评级", "债项评级", "中期票据", "短期融资", "企业债", "公司债"]
            
            links = page.locator("a, li").all()
            sub_menus = []
            seen_names = set()
            
            for link in links:
                if not link.is_visible(): continue
                txt = link.inner_text().strip()
                # 过滤掉过长的文本（可能是包含子菜单的父容器）
                if len(txt) > 20: 
                    continue
                if txt and txt not in seen_names and any(k in txt for k in potential_keywords):
                    seen_names.add(txt)
                    sub_menus.append(txt)
            
            # 兜底策略：如果没找到，尝试查找折叠菜单
            if not sub_menus:
                print("[INFO] 未直接发现子菜单，尝试查找折叠菜单...")
                el_submenus = page.locator(".el-submenu__title").filter(has_text="企业评级").all()
                for sm in el_submenus:
                    if sm.is_visible():
                        sm.click()
                        page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
                        items = page.locator(".el-menu-item").all()
                        for item in items:
                            if item.is_visible():
                                txt = item.inner_text().strip()
                                if txt and txt not in seen_names:
                                    seen_names.add(txt)
                                    sub_menus.append(txt)
                        break
            
            print(f"[INFO] 发现子板块: {sub_menus}")
            if not sub_menus:
                print("[WARN] 未能识别任何子板块，将尝试直接抓取当前页...")
                sub_menus = ["默认板块"]

            # 4. 遍历板块
            for sub_name in sub_menus:
                if sub_name == "默认板块":
                    pass 
                else:
                    print(f"\n{'='*40}")
                    print(f"[INFO] 切换板块: {sub_name}")
                    try:
                        # 点击板块链接
                        link = page.get_by_text(sub_name, exact=True).first
                        if not link.is_visible():
                             link = page.get_by_text(sub_name, exact=False).first
                        
                        if link.is_visible():
                            link.click()
                            page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
                        else:
                            print(f"[WARN] 无法点击板块: {sub_name}")
                            continue
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"[WARN] 切换板块出错: {e}")
                        continue

                # 5. 翻页抓取
                page_num = 1
                stop_category = False
                consecutive_date_misses = 0 # 连续日期不匹配计数，防止因置顶帖误判
                
                while not stop_category:
                    print(f"[INFO] 正在处理第 {page_num} 页...")
                    
                    try:
                        page.wait_for_selector("tr, .row, .el-table__row", timeout=5000)
                    except:
                        print("[INFO] 等待数据超时或无数据")
                        if page_num == 1:
                            print("[WARN] 第一页无数据，跳过此板块")
                        break

                    rows = page.locator("tr:not(:has(th)), div.row:not(.header)").all()
                    visible_rows = [r for r in rows if r.is_visible()]
                    
                    if not visible_rows:
                        print("[INFO] 未找到可见的数据行")
                        break
                        
                    print(f"[INFO] 本页发现 {len(visible_rows)} 行数据")
                    
                    page_has_valid_date = False
                    
                    for row in visible_rows:
                        try:
                            row_text = row.inner_text()
                            
                            # 提取日期
                            date_match = re.search(r"(\d{4}[-/年\.]\d{1,2}[-/月\.]\d{1,2})", row_text)
                            if not date_match:
                                continue
                                
                            date_str = date_match.group(1)
                            date_val = normalize_date(date_str)
                            
                            if not date_val:
                                continue
                            
                            page_has_valid_date = True
                            
                            # 日期范围检查
                            if date_val < START_DATE:
                                consecutive_date_misses += 1
                                # 只有连续 5 条记录都早于起始日期，才认为真的结束了（防止置顶帖干扰）
                                if consecutive_date_misses >= 5:
                                    print(f"[INFO] 连续 {consecutive_date_misses} 条记录日期({date_val})早于起始日期，停止当前板块")
                                    stop_category = True
                                    break
                                continue
                            
                            if date_val > END_DATE:
                                continue
                            
                            # 重置连续未命中计数
                            consecutive_date_misses = 0
                                
                            # 提取标题和链接
                            links = row.locator("a").all()
                            title = "无标题"
                            download_url = ""
                            file_type = "html"
                            
                            pdf_link = row.locator("a[href$='.pdf']").first
                            if pdf_link.count() > 0:
                                title = pdf_link.inner_text().strip() or "PDF报告"
                                raw_url = pdf_link.get_attribute("href")
                                download_url = urljoin(page.url, raw_url)
                                file_type = "pdf"
                            elif links:
                                for l in links:
                                    txt = l.inner_text().strip()
                                    href = l.get_attribute("href")
                                    if txt and len(txt) > 4 and href and "javascript" not in href:
                                        title = txt
                                        download_url = urljoin(page.url, href)
                                        break
                            
                            if not download_url:
                                continue
                                
                            if title == "无标题":
                                title = row_text.split("\n")[0][:50]

                            print(f"[MATCH] {date_val} | {title}")
                            
                            all_reports.append({
                                "name": title,
                                "date": date_val,
                                "downloadUrl": download_url,
                                "fileType": file_type,
                                "category": sub_name
                            })
                            
                        except Exception as e:
                            continue
                            
                    if stop_category:
                        break
                    
                    # 如果整页都没有有效日期（可能是格式变了），也应该警惕，但暂时继续翻页
                    if not page_has_valid_date and page_num > 1:
                        print("[WARN] 本页未提取到任何有效日期，可能已到达末尾或格式变更")
                        # break # 暂时不break，防止偶发
                        
                    # 翻页逻辑
                    try:
                        next_btn = page.locator("button.btn-next, a.next, li.next").first
                        if not next_btn.is_visible():
                            next_btn = page.get_by_text("下一页", exact=True).first
                            if not next_btn.is_visible():
                                next_btn = page.get_by_text(">", exact=True).first
                        
                        if next_btn.is_visible():
                            is_disabled = "disabled" in (next_btn.get_attribute("class") or "") or next_btn.get_attribute("disabled")
                            if not is_disabled:
                                next_btn.click()
                                page_num += 1
                                page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
                            else:
                                print("[INFO] 下一页按钮禁用，翻页结束")
                                break
                        else:
                            print("[INFO] 未找到下一页按钮，翻页结束")
                            break
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"[WARN] 翻页失败: {e}")
                        break
                        
                    if page_num > 50:
                        break

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[ERROR] 爬虫运行出错: {e}")
        finally:
            browser.close()
            
    save_results(all_reports)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
